text: Chapter 11: Off to Toram@The Strolling Forest
■Next Mission\nStart from Fugitive Lake Swamp: Area 3.
You wake up and find yourself in a moving forest, a place\ncompletely different from where you were the day before. For\nnow, try going to the place with a noticeably towering tree!
You intend to go further but end up going around in circles.\nFind the right entrance to the Inner Area from the\nLost Woods to proceed further!
Defeat the monsters living in the forest and head to the\nplace where the towering tree is!
The towering giant tree and Ferzen, a rock dragon, are\nfighting. The giant tree is the only one taking damage\nbecause it can't move. Protect it and defeat the dragon!
To help the wounded giant tree, go collect 20 Broken Horns\nthat can be used to heal the wounds!
